prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: API 错误码排查对照表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "错误码" · longest unbreakable word 49px · one-line width 49px
  col 2: header "错误信息" · longest unbreakable word 154px · one-line width 154px
  col 3: header "含义" · longest unbreakable word 95px · one-line width 740px
  col 4: header "解决办法" · longest unbreakable word 110px · one-line width 1964px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
This table cannot fit without splitting words at 360px. You MAY choose a total wider than 359px (the reader then scrolls horizontally), or squeeze and accept splits — a design decision.
Rendering convention: the screenshot always shows the WHOLE table. Anything beyond the dashed box is not clipped; it is the part a reader reaches by scrolling sideways, so judge both what fits in the box at first sight and the cost of scrolling to the rest.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"帮助开发者根据 API 错误码定位问题，并查阅原因和解决办法。","reading":"读者通常先扫描错误码或错误信息定位一行，再横向阅读含义和解决办法；各行需要保持清晰，方便比较相近错误。","groups":["错误码和错误信息共同标识问题，宜靠近并保持标识符完整。","含义和解决办法共同构成排查说明；两列都是自然语言，但解决办法更长，应获得更多宽度。"],"keep_intact":["错误码及英文错误信息标识符，如 INVALID_CREDENTIAL。","说明中的 AppID、access_token、AppSecret、OpenID 和 OAuth2 等技术词汇宜尽量保持完整。"],"may_wrap":["含义和解决办法中的中文说明可按语义自然换行。","较短单元格可利用同一行由长解决办法形成的高度容纳换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [70, 175, 140, 260] · table 646×1500px · row heights [36, 199, 222, 199, 199, 222, 199, 222] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 9 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 286px
Design r1B: widths [70, 175, 116, 230] · table 592×1733px · row heights [36, 222, 246, 222, 246, 246, 246, 269] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 11 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 232px
Design r1C: widths [70, 175, 125, 300] · table 671×1407px · row heights [36, 222, 199, 199, 176, 199, 176, 199] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 9 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 311px

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"错误码和英文错误信息完整，定位一行很方便；含义列比另外两版宽，中文说明的换行较从容。解决办法获得较多宽度，行高也较均衡。","problems":"首屏只显示含义列的一部分，解决办法需要横向滚动才能阅读；部分行的标识列留下较大空白。","cause":"前两列共占245px，含义列为140px，使其右侧越过360px视口；260px的解决办法列承载较长文本，决定了多数行高。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"错误码和错误信息保持完整；116px的含义列基本落在首屏内，横向滚动距离是三版中最短的。","problems":"含义列中文换行频繁，解决办法也较窄，表格明显更高；长行使短标识下方的空白增多，跨行比较费力。","cause":"含义列仅有95px内容宽度，解决办法列仅有209px内容宽度，长说明因此被挤成更多行。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"错误码和错误信息完整；300px的解决办法列让长说明更舒展，整体高度是三版中最低的。","problems":"含义列仍显狭窄，部分中文短语换行零碎；首屏不能完整显示含义列，解决办法需滚动较远才能读到。","cause":"含义列125px，仅有104px内容宽度；前两列共245px，加上较宽的解决办法列，使总宽达到671px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced","widths":[70,175,135,285],"change":"以r1C为基础，给含义列增加10px，并将解决办法列收窄15px；保持标识符完整，改善含义的换行，同时保留较宽的解决办法列。"},{"name":"viewport-meaning","widths":[70,175,114,280],"change":"将含义列压至114px，使前三列合计359px，首屏可完整查看标识和含义；解决办法保留280px，通过横向滚动阅读。需留意含义中的最长技术词可能被拆开。"},{"name":"wide-explanation","widths":[70,175,155,300],"change":"保留r1C的解决办法宽度，把含义列扩至155px，探索更舒展的说明和更协调的行高；代价是增加横向滚动距离。"}]}
